scope: Post-hoc CPU sanity baseline audit; exact forward state-probability propagation, no model, sampling, tuning or reserved scores
algorithm: Start with probability one at S; distribute each active mass equally over four custom actions using actual env.P and action_map; absorb hole/goal; enforce 10-action horizon; E[T]=sum active mass before each turn; per-task Pass4=1-(1-p)^4 then average tasks
limitations: Expectation, not an observed 400-trajectory model score; no statistical superiority claim.
Four random trajectories are independent within each map; Pass4 is the average of per-map 1-(1-p)^4, not 1-(1-average(p))^4.
Four valid direction commands include boundary collisions and moves into holes; they are not restricted to safe/moving actions.
No language model response or RLen is defined; this auxiliary calculation does not replace any prespecified model endpoint.
